newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open lower.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open lower.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were expected to open lower Tuesday in line with LME copper after a further rise in LME warehouse copper stocks today.
COMEX September copper was called unchanged to down 0.50 cent from Monday's close of 109.70 cents a lb after trading from 109.65 to 108.50 cents on ACCESS.
LME copper stocks rose a further 6,475 tonnes Tuesday to 220,600 tonnes, the highest level in three months, as the seasonally slow summer period continues to see demand ease.
COMEX copper stocks rose 3,316 short tons Monday to 28,505 short tons, following a shift in the arbitrage in favor of COMEX.
Copper prices recovered in the past week from a three-month low set in early July in the wake of a rally to a 12-month high.
